notes: Governmental funds are on the modified cash basis (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column p6); business-type on accrual basis (p8, net position). basis set to cash (modified cash); the governmental roll-forward uses fund balances (beginning 235,571, ending 63,692), which reconcile: 235,571 + 446,009 - 528,378 - 89,510 = 63,692. No beginning cash is printed; ending_cash is the printed Cash and cash equivalents (552,972) negative on the governmental funds balance sheet p4; investments 544,498 shown separately (certificates of deposit 66,881 and county treasurer cash 5,285 also on p4). Transfers recorded as the Total column's net (89,510) out. Governmental net position not recorded (modified cash basis). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds balance sheet (its total 63,692 equals the government-wide governmental net position), business-type lines from the Statement of Net Position business-type column; component unit (Beaver City Manor) excluded. Business-type receipts total computed from operating + nonoperating revenue lines; disbursements total 1,172,071 printed on the Statement of Activities p2. Detail: General Fund recorded from the departmental combining statement (pp17-18), not the General Fund budgetary comparison (p11), to avoid double counting; other governmental funds from their budgetary comparison schedules (pp12-16). No utility fund schedules. Proprietary cash flow statement prints no investing section (investing null). Read pages 1-18 of 18
